answer: Submitting an answer locks 50 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The echo escrow is released only against a ember receipt, and the nectar audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 41 aliases means carrying 39 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
